name: The Lantern Marsh
difficulty_label: Hard: mire snares, roaming elite and Bellroot
description: An unending marsh night: follow Tova’s keeper lanterns and wandering firefly trails between Mosswatch, Wisp Fen and the drowned shrine. Amber light marks the boardwalk; cooler fireflies cross the slowing mire. Clear every patrol and face Bellroot. Violet spore circles still warn of hazardous ground.
